title: Jahmyr Gibbs in Hall of Fame company with a long list of statistical achievements

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs in Hall of Fame company with a long list of statistical achievements
sources.description: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs had another phenomenal game on Sunday, and in his fourth NFL season he has hit a long list of statistical milestones that only Hall of Famers have reached before him.
